title: centaurium breviflorum
intro: Centaurium breviflorum, commonly known as Short-flowered Centaury, is a perennial plant species in the gentian family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Centaurium breviflorum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as treating respiratory and urinary tract infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
